project_and_history_contract.identity: The existing WorkspaceId is project identity; paths and marker are locators.

project_and_history_contract.mutation: One exact-base proposal publishes exactly one immutable snapshot, one canonical record, and HEAD; validate-only, no-change, stale, rejected, and response-preflight failure publish nothing.
project_and_history_contract.history: Contiguous revisions from zero; compact record chain; bounded log/show; exact endpoint semantic diff; restoration publishes forward and rejects identity resurrection.
project_and_history_contract.ordinary_open: Scans every retained path, decodes every compact record, validates the record chain and HEAD, and decodes the current/idempotency snapshots without decoding unrelated historical graphs.
project_and_history_contract.historical_open: The selected historical artifact is decoded on demand and checked against its record result digest.
project_and_history_contract.deep_doctor: Decodes all snapshots, checks all adjacent history transitions, and recomputes every record diff/entity/target fact.
project_and_history_contract.backup: No-replace staged copy followed by independent project open; paths do not enter semantic identity.

unperformed_and_limits: No commit, push, pull request, release, merge, or remote mutation was authorized or performed.
No provider/model/token-class/price telemetry was available; no cost estimate is made.
Measurements used a warm host and mostly an unoptimized development binary; no cold or statistical performance claim is made.
Physical filesystem write volume and exact peak RSS were unavailable.
Linux x86-64 is the only exercised platform.
Miri, sanitizers, model checking, long-running fuzzing, hardware power-loss injection, and cross-platform execution were not run.
A production TUI, terminal interface, filesystem interface, background scheduler, cancellation, network, secrets, and multi-user authorization were deliberately not implemented.
No incomplete accepted target state, external cross-project target dependency, branch/merge model, database, build cache, daemon, bytecode, JIT, or native tier was implemented.
The 2,000-task / 10,000-mutation product stress profile was not run; the retained 500-task representative profile remains the product scale evidence.
The appendices contain more exhaustive fault combinations than were individually rerun in this campaign; retained focused invariant tests and the final full gate define the verified subset.
